about: The accounts allowlist of the realtime Worker’s /db routes (AUTH-3): the statement skeletons the accounts code sends, recorded by apps/studio/src/server/auth/record-statements.test.ts (@turboslide/realtime/d1-statements has the skeleton rule). Regenerate with TURBOSLIDE_RECORD_STATEMENTS=write node_modules/.bin/vitest run apps/studio/src/server/auth/record-statements.test.ts; never edit by hand.
statements: delete from "deviceCode" where "deviceCode"."id" in (select "deviceCode"."id" from "deviceCode" where ("deviceCode"."id" = ? and "deviceCode"."clientId" = ? and "deviceCode"."status" = ?) limit ?) returning *
delete from "verification" where "verification"."id" in (select "verification"."id" from "verification" where "verification"."id" = ? limit ?) returning *
insert into "ts_principal" ({columns}) values ({values}) on conflict ("principal_id") do update set "record" = ?, "last_seen_at" = ?, "expires_at" = ?
select "anonymousId" from "ts_alias" where "userId" = ? order by "linkedAt" asc
select "avatarKey" from "ts_profile" where "avatarKey" is not null
select "primary".* from (select * from "account" where "account"."userId" = ? limit ?) as "primary"
select "primary".* from (select * from "account" where ("account"."providerId" = ? and "account"."accountId" = ?) limit ?) as "primary"
select "primary".* from (select * from "session" where "session"."token" = ? limit ?) as "primary"
select "primary".* from (select * from "session" where "session"."userId" = ? limit ?) as "primary"
select "primary".* from (select * from "session" where ("session"."userId" = ? and "session"."expiresAt" > ?) limit ?) as "primary"
select "primary".* from (select * from "user" where "user"."id" = ? limit ?) as "primary"
select "primary".* from (select * from "verification" where "verification"."expiresAt" < ? limit ?) as "primary"
select "primary".* from (select * from "verification" where "verification"."identifier" = ? limit ?) as "primary"
select "primary".* from (select * from "verification" where "verification"."identifier" = ? order by "createdAt" desc limit ?) as "primary" order by "createdAt" desc
select * from "ts_api_key" where "userId" = ? order by "createdAt" asc
select * from "ts_mail" order by "createdAt" desc limit ?
select * from "ts_mail" where "createdAt" > ? order by "createdAt" desc limit ?

update "deviceCode" set {assignments} where ("deviceCode"."id" = ? and "deviceCode"."status" = ? and "deviceCode"."userId" is null) and "deviceCode"."id" in (select "deviceCode"."id" from "deviceCode" where ("deviceCode"."id" = ? and "deviceCode"."status" = ? and "deviceCode"."userId" is null) limit ?) returning *
